name: motion-workspace
description: Workspace for @n-uf/motion (how things move: one frame loop with an injected clock, springs and tweens, a gesture recognizer, the drag intent and the landing model), @n-uf/placement (where things fit: the edge cut, the edge fit, tiling and the popup positioner) and @n-uf/docking (where panels and toolbars dock).

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @n-uf/motion build && pnpm --filter @n-uf/placement build && pnpm --filter @n-uf/docking build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @n-uf/motion typecheck && pnpm --filter @n-uf/placement typecheck && pnpm --filter @n-uf/docking typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @n-uf/motion test && pnpm --filter @n-uf/placement test && pnpm --filter @n-uf/docking test && pnpm --filter @n-uf/docking test:sweep
scripts.check:quick: pnpm --filter @n-uf/motion check && pnpm --filter @n-uf/placement check && pnpm --filter @n-uf/docking check:quick && pnpm --filter motion-lab typecheck && pnpm dirt && pnpm changes && pnpm public-words && pnpm terminology
scripts.version:bump: pnpm --filter @n-uf/motion version:bump && node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && node scripts/changelog.mjs join
